connectorUiConfig.title: Cybersixgill Actionable Alerts (Serverless)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: The Cybersixgill Actionable Alerts data connector provides the capability to ingest Cybersixgill threat intelligence alerts into Microsoft Sentinel using the REST API. The connector provides visibility into actionable security alerts from the dark web and other underground sources, enabling security teams to respond to emerging threats.

sampleQueries.query:
CybersixgillActionableAlerts_CL
| where ThreatLevel == 'imminent'
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

CybersixgillActionableAlerts_CL
| mv-expand Threats
| summarize Count=count() by tostring(Threats)
| sort by Count desc

CybersixgillActionableAlerts_CL
| where isnotempty(CveId)
| project TimeGenerated, AlertName, CveId, CveDveScore, ThreatLevel
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

dataTypes.name: CybersixgillActionableAlerts_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
CybersixgillActionableAlerts_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| summarize Time=max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)

customs.name: Cybersixgill API Credentials
customs.description: A Cybersixgill API Client ID and Client Secret are required. [See the documentation to learn more about Cybersixgill API](https://onboarding.cybersixgill.com/documents/CyberSixgill%20API%20User%20Guide.pdf).

instructionSteps.title: 1. Get Cybersixgill API Credentials
instructionSteps.description:
To obtain your Cybersixgill API credentials:

1. Navigate to the [Cybersixgill Developer Portal](https://developer.cybersixgill.com)
2. Sign in with your Cybersixgill credentials
3. Click **GENERATE API CLIENT AND SECRET**
4. Save the Client ID and Client Secret for use in the next step

instructionSteps.title: 2. Configure the Cybersixgill Actionable Alerts connector
instructionSteps.description: Enter your Cybersixgill API credentials and optional organization ID below, then click **Connect** to start ingesting actionable alerts into Microsoft Sentinel.
